mentions.name: Valorant/CS2 AI-powered aim trainer
mentions.description: This tool is an AI-powered aim trainer for Valorant and CS2 that recreates the exact moments where a player missed shots. After a match, users enter the trainer and it boots up the same moment with enemies following their exact same pathing and gunplay feeling as close to 1:1 as possible with the original game. It works either via a custom-trained vision model that detects enemies plus a minimap-reading algorithm that infers the player's position, or by decoding downloaded replay files to grab real-time positions and timestamps for a perfect replication of the match.
mentions.problem: Players want to improve at Valorant or CS2 by practicing the exact moments in matches where they missed their shots.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A valorant / cs2 AI-powered aim trainer.

The way it works is you play a game of valorant, or cs2, then after the match you're able to look at the times where you missed your shot, enter our AI aim trainer, and it boots up that exact same moment, with enemies following their exact same pathing, with gunplay feeling as close to 1:1 as possible with the game you're trying to improve on.
